from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,shutil
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from backtest.scripts.maintenance import experiment_harness as harness
ext=root/'backtest/experiments/models/train-data/dft-specialists-20261108-v1/extensions'
prior=ext/'weekly-h5-four-20261113'
old=prior/'experts'
base=root/'backtest/experiments/models/early-stopping/weekly-h5-quantile10-rankic-20261114'
tmp=Path(__file__).parent
eid='early-stopping/weekly-h5-quantile10-rankic-20261114'
for sub in ['docs','configs','metrics','data','reports','source-records']:(base/sub).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def save(p,o):p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def rel(p):return str(p.relative_to(root))
prep=read(old/'configs/prepared-inputs.json')
for k in ['feature_manifest','validation_manifest','day_weights','eval_regime','training_target','baseline_manifest','target_audit','frozen_st']:
    v=prep[k];p=root/v['path'];assert p.stat().st_size==v['size'] and hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==v['sha256']
cal=root/'backtest/result/20261103_h20_causal_inputs/evaluation-provider/calendars/day.txt'
assert cal.read_text().strip().splitlines()[-1]==prep['data_version']== '2026-11-03'
for v in ['T','P','D','F']:
    f=prep['subsets'][v]['target'];p=root/f['path'];assert p.is_file() and hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==f['sha256']
cfg=base/'configs/evaluation.yaml';shutil.copyfile(old/'configs/evaluation.yaml',cfg)
eid_title='周度 H5 四风格专家 · 十档标签 RankIC 早停'
save(base/'metadata.json',dict(schema_version=1,entity_type='experiment',exp_id=eid,archive_path=rel(base),direction='early-stopping',kind='model',track='all_a',phase='M',title=eid_title))
families=['T','P','D','F']
hyp='在本风格验证日用预测与 H5 十档标签的日截面 Spearman 均值选轮，消除股票代码在早停中的作用，并检验各专家的 Top3×H5 净年化与夏普是否均高于 v5。'
spec=dict(hypothesis=hyp,variants=families,loss='weighted mse on frozen H5 stock quantile10 targets',validation='Same 1448-session cached H5 universe; grade all finite stocks in each original filtered validation cross section before splitting by its weekly style. No ex-post t+1 entry rejection in a prediction-quality RankIC. Average ties; ten right-closed bins; positive training affine score. Equal weight per valid day; min 20 stocks. No inner validation.',patience=50,upper=200,signal_end='2026-07-23',evaluation_end='2026-07-31',scored_days=prep['eval_day_counts'],tie_check='Replay every round with reversed stock order in each day; same best iteration and abs error <1e-12. Audit official final Top3 boundary.',gate='Each style must pass tie check and both own-style official ensemble net_ann and net_sharpe strictly exceed the frozen v5 on the identical dates. RankIC supplementary. If any passes, backtest with v5 fallback for all unqualified styles. All four reported separately.',backtests='Frozen primary lgb_full next-day forecast at t close. Use predicted label for the next session assigned to expert signals, also verify against one-session offset with same-day decision restrictions. Hard routes approved experts else v5; probability blend of approved standardized expert signals plus remaining mass on v5. Compare same execution v5 and historical s5. Same predeclared Top3 H5 ladder execution, historical window/cost, no fitted routing thresholds.',control='Old Top5-ES experts D/F/T/P and v5, all use exact prior official evaluation datasets and protocol.',anchor='T full-universe canonical output for native one-parent result; all four internal candidates and gate shown in the report, never publish anchor as a routed result.',temporary=str(tmp))
sp=base/'configs/experiment.json';save(sp,spec)
state=base/'docs/harness-state.json'
sources=[cfg,sp,cal,old/'configs/prepared-inputs.json',prior/'docs/h5-target.json',old/'metrics/v5.json',old/'docs/early-stopping-review.json',prior/'classifier/metrics/ensemble-lgb_full.csv',prior/'classifier/metrics/evaluation.json']
sources += [root/prep[k]['path'] for k in ['feature_manifest','validation_manifest','day_weights','eval_regime','baseline_manifest','frozen_st']]
sources += [root/prep['subsets'][v]['target']['path'] for v in families]
sources += [root/s for s in ['backtest/models/regime_adapt.py','backtest/models/rankic_early_stop.py','backtest/scripts/train/train_regime_arm.py','backtest/scripts/evaluate/eval_ic_multi_pool.py']]
plan=dict(schema_version=2,campaign_id='weekly-h5-quantile10-rankic-20261114',idea=hyp,track='all_a_model',direction='early-stopping',anchor_exp_id=eid,archive_path=rel(base),baseline_ref=harness._baseline(root,'all_a_model')['exp_id'],allowed_changes=['own_style_es_on_H5_quantile10_rankic'],selection_rule=spec['gate'],data_version=prep['data_version'],inputs=[rel(p) for p in sources],seeds=[42,1000,2000,3000,4000],budget=dict(max_rounds=1,max_variants=1,max_attempts_per_variant=3,max_wall_hours=12,max_no_new_evidence_rounds=1,concurrency=1),execution_budget=dict(max_model_fits=28,new_label_horizons=[5]),scientific_candidates=families,temporary_directory=str(tmp))
save(base/'configs/harness-plan.json',plan)
h=harness.initialize(base/'configs/harness-plan.json',repo_root=root)
for e in [dict(type='plan_variant',exp_id=eid,round=1,archive_path=rel(base),hypothesis=hyp,changed_axis=plan['allowed_changes'][0],configs=[rel(sp),rel(cfg)]),dict(type='start',exp_id=eid,command=[sys.executable,str(tmp/'run.py')])]:
    h=harness.append_event(state,e,expected_revision=h['revision'],repo_root=root)
print('native campaign',h['status'],h['revision'])
src=read(old/'docs/adapter-common.json')['source_text'].split('CONTRACT=')[0]
src=src.replace("BASE=CAMPAIGN/'experts'",f"PREVEX=CAMPAIGN/'experts'\nBASE=ROOT/{rel(base)!r}").replace("EID='train-data/dft-specialists-20261108-v1'",f"EID={eid!r}").replace("STAGE='weekly-h5-four'","STAGE='weekly-h5-rankic'").replace("VARIANTS=['ALL',*STYLES]","VARIANTS=['T','P','D','F']").replace("CONTROLS=['v5','old-D','old-F','old-T']","CONTROLS=[]").replace("20261113_weekly_h5_four","20261114_weekly_rankic")
(tmp/'common.py').write_text(src)
for n in ['infer','evaluate']:
    src=read(old/f'docs/adapter-{n}.json')['source_text']
    src=src.replace('len(jobs)==25','len(jobs)==20').replace('weekly-h5-four-20261113','weekly-h5-quantile10-rankic-20261114')
    if n=='evaluate':
        src=src.replace("'changed_axis':'weekly_h5_four_and_H5_stock_quantile_target'","'changed_axis':'own_style_H5_quantile10_rankic_early_stopping'")
    (tmp/f'{n}.py').write_text(src)
save(base/'docs/study-progress.json',dict(jobs=[],scientific_candidates={v:{'status':'planned'} for v in families}))
purpose: Task-only adapter; source retained as audit, executable removed at closure.
